\section{Execution}

Every category runs from the same command; the suite is not split by marker or path in either the Makefile or CI:

\texttt{poetry run pytest -\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}cov=feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent -\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}cov-\allowbreak{}report=term-\allowbreak{}missing -\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}cov-\allowbreak{}fail-\allowbreak{}under=\$(COVERAGE\_\allowbreak{}THRESHOLD)\allowbreak{}}.

The suite requires no network access, no database, and no API key: the deterministic local LLM provider and the JSON vector store are the defaults, and optional integrations are exercised through injected fakes.
